name: Challenge Timer
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: MrStilu2k6
description: Server-side challenge timer that shows your playtime and in-game day in the action bar. Optional challenge mode: on death the run fails, the death screen is skipped and everyone goes spectator. Restart into a fresh world with one command.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
